conclusion: DeepDub has NO working non-verbal tag. Three of seven tag spellings are READ ALOUD (ברף/ברית/בריבס) — a worse failure mode than Cartesia's silent swallow, and consistent with 3d's finding that <break> markup is read aloud too. Breathing on DeepDub is NATIVE-ONLY (which is what Koren approved 5/5 in round 22). Pre-flip requirement: a SQUARE_TAG net in speech-guard so a stray LLM bracket token never reaches an engine that speaks it. Instrument note: every transcript above is non-empty and coherent (baselines match sent text), so the Int16Array/Buffer trap 3d hit does not apply to this batch — dd_probe24.ts builds the Int16Array view explicitly.
